English.Char_Desc_2000:
HOL Guard is local-first runtime control for AI coding agents.
Installed on your Windows machine, HOL Guard can gate shell, secrets and file reads, MCP server changes, and plugin or skill installs. Risky actions go through local approvals and receipts so you stay in control of what agents do at runtime.
HOL Guard is freeware / open source under the Apache-2.0 license. Maker: HOL. Canonical product page: https://hol.org/guard. Install / MSI: https://hol.org/guard/install.
Honest limits: scan is not a safety guarantee. Catalog scores and modeled benchmarks are not marketing guarantees. Do not confuse HOL Guard with antivirus or network firewall products.
Windows desktop package: HOL-Guard-Desktop-0.1.0-beta.51-x64.msi (public download via hol.org).

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: The freeware version of HOL Guard may be freely distributed over the internet in an unchanged form.
